x_broadcast.basis: root -> farthest SM multicast depth (SU -> VM hub hop + VM -> x face) + meso, once per serial x load (the first not-resident load after a producer; later loads of the group stream behind it)

barrier_wire_delta.basis: arrive + release over the routed control tree (58 each way incl. meso) replacing the 29 + 29 wire cycles inside the measured 62-cycle barrier RTL

result_gather.basis: SM -> SU result gather travels with the arrive; exposed only beyond the barrier round trip

su_coll_endpoint.basis: SU -> collective endpoint and back, once per collective

endpoint_serdes.basis: endpoint -> farthest SerDes macro (flit striped over 9 macros) and back, per switch crossing; the TU budget (PHY + switch + cable) excludes the on-die run

expert_fetch_wire.basis: router -> stream service descriptor + stream service -> farthest SM weight line, per data-dependent expert fetch (the measured first access is at the controller)

kv_rows_wire.basis: stream service -> scan quadrant (near-HBM attention) per first-access KV / window / embedding read

index_keys_wire.basis: stream service -> index quarter per index scan

attn_out_wire.basis: tile row end -> index quarter -> SU per attention step

attn_q_wire.basis: VM -> corner tile query chain + packet hops to the farthest tile + meso, per attention step (r15)

rows.note: the MTP step carries the same die-level traversals as the AR walk (the P6 verify walk has the AR node sequence; the draft is off-die-path); today-clock rows priced at 1.2 GHz wire stages (conservative: their SM clock is lower)

qwen_8k.scope: HA8 W12 vehicle mapped to this die's collective and stream-service geometry: per switch crossing endpoint <-> farthest SerDes both ways, SU <-> endpoint once per collective, stream service -> compute once per layer with a KV first access.  The W12 spine/tile tree (BD31, NWS/TWS) is measured inside its cycles; the W12 tile die (1,536 tiles, 421.5 MiB SRAM residence, ~382 mm2 tile core) is NOT this SM die and is not floorplanned here

stages_430.basis: BOUND: longest k16 bundle of each routed segment (every bit registered in time)

stages_430_median_bundle.basis: median bundle of each routed segment (GRT outlier detours excluded)

stages_430_mean_bundle.basis: mean bundle of each routed segment

stages_430_manhattan.basis: FLOOR: Manhattan length between the placed stations / pins of each segment (no detour)
